jobs.title: Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
**Investment Analyst Job Description**

**Investment Analysis, Research, Financial Modeling & Valuation**

o Conduct financial analysis, due diligence, and valuation for investment opportunities (Public equity, Fixed Income, direct, co-investments, funds) and prepare and reports and memo for the board.

o Perform valuation using comparable, precedent transactions, and sensitivity analysis.

o Support transaction execution, including deal structuring, financial modeling, and investment committee presentations.

o Monitor and manage existing portfolio investments, providing strategic recommendations.

o Assist in market research, industry analysis, and identifying investment trends within KSA and broader GCC markets.

o Ensure investments comply with policies, risk limits, and governance standards.

**Portfolio Execution, Monitoring & Reporting**

o Work closely with senior management and external advisors on investment strategies and portfolio performance.

o Support structuring, negotiations, and transaction documentation through closing.

o On-line trading, management and reporting of GCC (mainly KSA) investments.

o Accounting of investments (mainly public stocks & DPM) operation on Oracle and generating relevant reports.

o Monitoring and recording of dividends and distribution of all the investments

o Prepare periodic performance dashboards and management reports.

o Monitoring the performance of advisory and discretionary mandates with asset managers.

· **Relationships Management, KYC update & Compliance.**

o Engaging with Bank and brokerage house relationship managers.

o Updating of all KYC and compliance documents for all the Banks.

o Yearly Personal Zakat calculation for Board Members every Ramadan

**Educations & Skills:**

· English & Arabic (writing, reading & speaking) Proficiency is required.

· Bachelor or Master’s Degree Education in Finance, Economics or Business. CFA Candidacy

· 5 Year to 7 Years’ experience at the family office or Asset Management or Brokerage house or Bank.

· Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Refinitiv, etc.

· Knowhow of brokerage trading portals, Oracle/ERP data entry, reporting, & proficiency is excel & memo writing.

· Ability to manage multiple account, entities and deadlines.

· Integrity, confidentiality, and compliance mindset.

· Advanced financial modeling and valuation expertise.

· Clear communication and teamwork skills.

Work Location: In person
